notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for in-app assistant + semantic search. Team wants hosted API to prove integration quickly (done), now moving to Dedicated for EU data residency and predictable latency/costs. Shorthand notes:
- POC results: hosted API integration is straightforward; embeddings + reranking flow OK. Latency: p95 ~420ms on eu-west-1 under moderate load; goal p95 <300ms for chat snippets.
- Requirements from customer: EU-only residency (must not replicate to US), option for active-active within EU for regional failover, consistent per-token cost estimates, and private VPC peering.
- Security asks: SOC2 attestation, SSO via SAML, KMIP/KMS integration for customer-managed keys, audit logs (90d+ retention), contract language for data residency.
- Quote ask: dedicated monthly reserved capacity (GPU pool) + burst capacity pricing. They want both per-req and effective per-token unit economics to compare to OpenAI/Anthropic.
- Network: prefer VPC peering to eu-west infra; want egress cost estimates and advice on multi-region routing (latency vs. cost tradeoff).
